articles.summary: Upstream, the first personalized sperm health program for men, announces a pilot program in partnership with Legacy, Military Family Building Coalition (MFBC), and SiPhox Health launching October 15. The program will track improvements in sperm health among five active-duty service members and Veterans over a 10-week period, combining advanced diagnostics with personalized lifestyle coaching.
articles.title: Legacy partners with Upstream Fertility to support fertility pilot for active-duty service members and Veterans
